first_principles_point: Live presence is scarce because time, venue capacity, location, seats, rooms, and dates cannot scale like digital content.
money_path: scarce event/place/time -> ticket/room/table/resort booking -> operator/venue/platform -> labor/rent/rights/capex -> cash
company_examples: Live Nation; Disney Experiences; Marriott; Host Hotels; MGM; airlines; sports venues
proof_needed: attendance; occupancy; RevPAR; advance bookings; event-related deferred revenue; spend per visitor; debt burden
safe_use: Safe claim: presence can price differently from abundant content, but only when capacity and demand evidence support it.

first_principles_point: A membership is a paid relationship gate: once the customer pays to enter, the company can layer pricing, delivery, rewards, financing, ads, and data on top.

company_examples: Costco; Amazon; Uber One; American Express; Walmart Plus; streaming services; travel loyalty programs
proof_needed: members; renewal; fee revenue; member share of volume; rewards cost; fulfillment cost; ads; churn
safe_use: Safe claim: membership changes the relationship from transaction to account, but proof must show renewal economics and cost to serve.
